text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both in mild pullback mode with matching declines around 0.5–0.7% over 24 hours, suggesting consolidation rather than conviction in either direction. The Fear & Greed Index at 28 indicates genuine market caution that's intensifying (down 2 points week-over-week), while Bitcoin's dominance holding steady at 56.2% shows capital isn't fleeing to altcoins despite the broader weakness. Volume at $42B is moderate, consistent with a market taking a pause to reassess rather than capitulating.
